data.body: Third plan-review remediation: replaced the impossible deterministic-behavior proxy with the shipped live criterion-eval path, using eval_solver.run_case through rebar criteria eval T10 --runs 3. Planned a balanced four-case corpus that proves the transient private-probe exclusion, protects durable findings from over-suppression, and preserves b2 for untrusted-network transient services. Added an offline text and fixture-shape oracle, a direct negative oracle for T15 references, and updated file impact. P7 remains descriptive wording rather than a destructive operation. P6 was addressed by atomizing every eval outcome into its own AC. Note: the prior comment attempt accidentally shell-expanded backticked command names and invoked the absent T10 eval once; it failed cleanly on the missing planned fixture and changed no code.
